text:
2. 1. 3

Bhavanetti suttaṃ

162. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: bhavanetti bhavanettiti- bhante, vuccati. Katamā nu kho bhante, bhavanetti. Katamo bhavanettinirodhoti?

 rūpe kho rādha, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā. Ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. Tesaṃ nirodhā- bhavanettinirodho. Vedanāya yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. Tesaṃ nirodhā- bhavanettinirodhoti. Saññāya yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. Tesaṃ nirodhā- bhavanettinirodhoti. Saṃkhāresu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. Tesaṃ nirodhā- bhavanettinirodhoti. Viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. Tesaṃ nirodhā- bhavanettinirodhoti.
